content.text: Hatton's announcement comes after Pacquiao, 46, confirmed his return - a title bout with WBC welterweight champion Mario Barrios on 19 July - in May.
The most concerning scenario would be if Pacquiao delivers a satisfactory performance and sees it as a moral victory, believing he can continue, which could be perilous in the long run.
At 30 years old, American Barrios is 16 years junior to Pacquiao and boasts a record of 29 victories, one draw, and two defeats from his 32 professional bouts.
